user.title: Connect a Memolumen picture frame
user.description: Address of the Memolumen web interface (e.g. https://192.168.1.50:8443) and the API token from Memolumen under "Home Assistant → Control via REST".

data.verify_ssl: Verify certificate (only with your own trusted certificate)

reauth_confirm.title: Renew API token
reauth_confirm.description: The API token was changed in Memolumen. Please enter the current token from "Home Assistant → Control via REST".

error.cannot_connect: Memolumen cannot be reached at this address.

abort.already_configured: This picture frame is already set up.

show_camera.name: Show camera
show_camera.description: Shows the live image of a Home Assistant camera on the picture frame (e.g. door camera when the bell rings). Memolumen needs the Home Assistant address and a token in its settings.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the image stays on screen.

title.name: Title
title.description: Heading, e.g. "Someone is at the door".

show_image.name: Show image
show_image.description: Shows an image by address (http/https or a Home Assistant path like /api/camera_proxy/…).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the image stays on screen.

notify.name: Show message
notify.description: Shows a message as a banner at the top of the picture frame.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the message stays visible.

dismiss.name: Close overlay
dismiss.description: Closes a camera or image overlay.

display_on_for.name: Turn screen on temporarily
display_on_for.description: Turns the screen on for some minutes, even outside the operating hours.

init.title: Motion sensors and doorbell

data_description.motion_sensors: One or more motion or presence sensors in the room where the frame stands. If a sensor stays "on" (presence), motion is reported again every minute.
data_description.doorbell_triggers: One or more entities, e.g. a doorbell input (binary sensor "on"), a doorbell event or a button. Every trigger counts as a ring.
data_description.doorbell_camera: This camera is shown when the doorbell rings.
data_description.doorbell_duration: How long the camera image stays on the frame.
data_description.doorbell_title: Heading of the overlay, e.g. "Someone is at the door".
data_description.doorbell_subtitle: Second line, e.g. the camera name.
data_description.doorbell_cooldown: Further triggers during this time are ignored (prevents repeats on a long press).
data_description.doorbell_webhook: Home Assistant provides an address; when a device in your home network calls it (GET or POST), the doorbell rings on the frame.
data_description.doorbell_webhook_id: Any ID (letters, digits, - and _). To keep an existing Shelly setting, enter the previous ID here and disable the old automation first.

operation.name: Operation & schedule
operation.description: When the frame is on. Values are read from the frame and sent to it on save (requires Memolumen 3.0.0).

data.idle_mode: How to turn off without motion
data.wake_at_night: Turn on at night on motion
data.wake_duration_minutes: After motion at night stay on for

data_description.mode: Schedule: on during the periods below. Always on: permanently on. Motion only: on with motion, off after the time without motion (needs a motion sensor or the camera).
data_description.idle_off_minutes: Required for "Motion only"; with "Schedule" the frame also turns off within the periods (0 = never).
data_description.wake_at_night: Only with "Schedule": motion outside the periods turns the frame on for the given duration.
data_description.block1_days: Periods without weekdays are not used. Off time before on time = across midnight.

error.trigger_required: Please select at least one trigger or enable "Doorbell via webhook".
error.webhook_in_use: This webhook ID is already in use (e.g. by an automation). Disable the automation first or choose another ID.
error.webhook_invalid: Only letters, digits, - and _ are allowed.
error.schedule_empty: For mode "Schedule" enter at least one period with weekdays.
error.schedule_block_invalid: A period needs different on and off times.
error.idle_required: For "Motion only" enter a time without motion of at least 1 minute.
error.cannot_connect: The frame cannot be reached – operation & schedule were not sent.
